name: io.github.Ryrahul/session-relay
title: Session Relay
description: Share coding-agent sessions with your team: /share in one agent, /pickup in another.

environmentVariables.name: RELAY_SERVER
environmentVariables.description: URL of your team's Session Relay server. Optional if you ran relay login.

environmentVariables.name: RELAY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Personal access token (srk_...) from Settings → Tokens. Optional if you ran relay login.
